title: Revealed Convex Preference
abstract: arXiv:2610.34771v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Convexity of preferences is a pervasive assumption in economic analysis, so it is important to understand how this property is revealed in data. In this paper, we develop a method to test for convexity given partial preference information in the form of weak and strict incomplete orders. We characterize the pairs that can be extended to convex preferences and provide an efficient algorithm to verify this property. Requiring the convex preference to align with an order that satisfies independence, such as the Euclidean order or stochastic dominance, does not complicate the test. We apply our results to consumer demand, choice under risk and uncertainty, and preferences over information, and establish conditions under which upper semicontinuity or continuity can also be obtained. translated_abstract: 偏好的凸性是经济分析中一个普遍存在的假设，因此理解这一性质如何在数据中显现十分重要。本文开发了一种方法，用于在给定以弱和严格不完备序形式表示的部分偏好信息的情况下检验凸性。我们刻画了可扩展为凸偏好的序对，并提供了一种高效算法来验证这一性质。要求凸偏好与满足独立性的序（如欧几里得序或随机占优）保持一致并不会使检验复杂化。我们将结果应用于消费者需求、风险和不确定性下的选择以及信息偏好等领域，并建立了在何种条件下还可以获得上半连续性或连续性的条件。我们识别了凸性在理性之外不施加额外限制的环境，将Afriat型结果扩展到无限数据和共同凸预算的情形。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于部分偏好信息（弱与严格不完备序）检验偏好凸性的方法，刻画了可扩展为凸偏好的序对并给出高效验证算法，且将结果应用于消费者需求、风险与不确定性下的选择以及信息偏好等领域。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a method to test for convexity of preferences given partial preference information in the form of incomplete orders, characterizes extendable pairs with an efficient algorithm, and applies the results to consumer demand, choice under risk and uncertainty, and preferences over information.
